text:
marina_docs: Hey team — opened a small docs PR to fix a couple of broken links and update the SDK snippet for v0.7. Wanted to check who can take the review and who can merge during the short release window tomorrow morning. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821

jonathan_eng: I can skim for the SDK bits (make sure the method names match runtime). Full review might be tight for me in the merge window though.

anya_product: @marina_docs can we get a docs reviewer + an eng reviewer assigned? Suggest @sam_docs for docs and @luis_reviewer for the merge. sam can do content review; luis can merge if CI is green.

sam_docs: I can review content today. Quick note — I'll be offline from 08:30-09:30 PST tomorrow, so if the merge window is in that slot, I won't be available to do a last-minute fix. Otherwise happy to take it.

luis_reviewer: I can be the merge owner. Will only merge after green CI + no unresolved comments. If anyone needs me to hold merge for a short canary window, say the time.

ci-bot: Automated check: docs preview failed linkcheck on the following files:
 - guides/migration/api-mapping.md: anchor #sdk-usage not found
 - examples/quickstart/index.md: external link https://old.example.com/ redirects
See the full CI log: https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/12345

marina_docs: Thanks — fixed the anchor in migration guide and swapped the external link to the new canonical URL. Also updated the SDK snippet to use the new client call:

```
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
const res = await client.text.generate({ model: 'rwd-large-v1', input: 'Translate to Spanish: Hello' });
console.log(res.output[0].text);
```

jonathan_eng: That snippet looks good but change `output[0].text` to `output_text` — the v0.7 SDK returns `output_text` now. Also add a one-line note about response shapes. I can push a tiny patch to the PR if you want.

marina_docs: Please do, @jonathan_eng — that would be faster. Also regen the docs preview after the patch. Command I used locally: `yarn docs:preview --open` (Netlify preview is flaky, so local check helps).

sam_docs: Quick checklist for reviewers: 1) Run snippet locally or validate shape, 2) confirm links & anchors, 3) basic grammar/spelling, 4) ensure the migration note is clear. I can go through 1-3 today.

ci-bot: Update: linkcheck fixed; preview build succeeded. Netlify: https://deploy-preview-4821--docs.redwood-inference.dev

luis_reviewer: I looked through the thread and the netlify preview. No unresolved comments. CI is green. I'll merge at 07:50 PST tomorrow to avoid the overlap with @sam_docs OOO window. Please add label `docs:patch` before merge.

marina_docs: Thanks everyone — added `docs:patch`. @luis_reviewer ping me once merged and I'll follow up to close the internal ticket. :pray:

luis_reviewer: Merged and tagged `docs:patch`. :merged:

marina_docs: Awesome, thank you all! :tada:
